action_instruction: Checking whether the Recent Expenses table contains an expense data row
intent: whether the Recent Expenses table contains at least one expense data row with a date, description, category, payment method, and dollar amount

action_params.condition: the table within this section contains at least one row with expense data (a date, description, category badge, payment method, and dollar amount)
action_params.query: whether the Recent Expenses table contains at least one expense data row with a date, description, category, payment method, and dollar amount
action_params.code_js: (() => { const rows = [...el(56).querySelectorAll('tr')]; return rows.some(tr => { const cells = [...tr.querySelectorAll('td')].map(td => td.textContent.trim()); return cells.length >= 5 && /[A-Za-z]{3} \d{1,2}, \d{4}/.test(cells[0]) && cells[1].length > 0 && cells[2].length > 0 && cells[3].length > 0 && /^\$\d[\d,]*(\.\d{2})?$/.test(cells[4]); }); })()
